title: R Draconis — a pulsating giant star
plain_result: Not measured yet. 1635 SPHEREx pictures of this variable star are available in the Time Machine. We tried a per-star test, but this star saturates SPHEREx's detector in almost every picture (3 usable of 250), so it cannot be measured with our method (What failed #16). The counts below are for the whole patch of sky, not for the star itself. On this patch the experimental colour-aware view flags more changes than the plain blink (2180 against 419); we have not established why, so these counts are not a measurement of the star.

numbers.label: Flagged changes, one detector at a time

method_note: Counts use the same rule as the 20-patch test (groups of ≥ 2 pixels beyond 5σ).
